name: Webex
description: Cisco Webex is an AI-powered collaboration platform for video meetings, webinars, calling, and messaging, with an in-house AI Assistant for transcription, translation, and meeting summaries.
best_for: Organizations that want video meetings, calling, and messaging in one app with in-house AI transcription and real-time translation.
features: Cisco AI Assistant with real-time transcription, closed captioning, and post-meeting summaries
"Catch Me Up" summaries of missed meeting discussion
Automatic action-item and highlight extraction from meetings
Real-time meeting translation into 120+ caption languages
Ask AI Assistant for Q&A on meeting content with citation links
Advanced keyword search across meeting recordings
In-house transcription management, with no customer data retained for model training

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free account includes unlimited messaging and calling with other Webex users, and meetings up to 40 minutes with up to 100 attendees in supported countries.

tiers.name: Meet
tiers.notes: Per license per month; meetings up to 24 hours with up to 200 attendees and 10 GB cloud meeting recording.

tiers.name: Meet + Call
tiers.notes: Per license per month; includes Meet features plus business calling capabilities.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Webex also offers enterprise plans; some plans require contacting sales.

alternatives.name: Zoom
alternatives.description: A video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and team chat used widely across businesses and education.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing reliable, widely adopted video conferencing

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A collaboration hub combining chat, video meetings, and file sharing tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.
strengths: Chat and video in one app

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: A cloud communications platform combining business phone, video meetings, team messaging, and AI-powered contact center tools.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses needing unified phone, video, and contact center in one platform
